notes.title: Fixed the bug and Enhance player experience
notes.content:
Fixed the bug in the fourth level and simplified the click operation.

Fixed a bug where QTE operations cannot modify buttons.

Fixed a bug where changing buttons was not saved.

Fixed some key errors in changing keys.

Added a button to reset the key on the modify key page.

Added a title to the main menu.

Fixed some minor bugs.



Thank you all for your support
